Dialogs.Dialog: Pheeew... Finally on break!
Anegasaki
Tell me about it~ Today's been pretty rough. I wish we'd win another trip to Atami.
(Oh, right! That Nikko-Kinugawa sweepstakes...)
It's not Atami, but guess what？ I actually won again!
You won...? Don't tell me... A trip？
You guessed it. A sweepstakes trip.
Wait, really!? Where to？ Somewhere with hot springs？
A 'Grown-Up School Trip' to Nikko & Kinugawa Onsen! Two days and one night!!
Ooh, Nikko and Kinugawa, huh...
Wait... A 'Grown-Up School Trip'？
Yeah. You visit all the classic school trip spots, aimed at adults.
A school trip, huh...
...Huh？ Not that into it？
No, it's not that, it's just... you know, us...
Komari
Nene-saaan, I can't do this! I don't get how the coupons work~!
Coming, coming! Be right there!
I'll go check on her, okay？ Oh, and let's finish this talk later.
Yeah, okay...
What part is tricky？ Did you scan the code first？
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s taking a while... Maybe ● should go help out too？)
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Sorry, sorry! I got totally tied up! So, let's go!
'Let's go'... To Nikko-Kinugawa？
Yep, the school trip!
Are you sure？ You seemed kinda hung up on something before.
Well... you know, we could never go together, right？ On a real school trip.
Well, yeah, since we're in different grades.
That just reminded me. You know how school trips are？ Couples get together...
I'd already given up on us ever getting to do something like that.
(So that's how ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ felt...)
But hearing what you said... we can just have our own school trip, right？ Together.
Exactly!
Hehe! Yay, a school trip! Hey, hey, when are we going？
Uh, we can figure out the exact date later, but...
Then it's settled. Starting ▲月▲▲日▲, our two-day school trip!
Okay! Alright, school trip time~! I've got so much to plan...
Plan what？
Hmm？ That's my little secret, ▼. Hehe!
(Awesome!! A school trip with just ● and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!)
All right! Break time, break time!
Anegasaki
Nice work.
Oh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Just finishing your break？
Yep. Just missed each other. Too baaad.
(Oh, right! I won that Nikko-Kinugawa prize trip again. Maybe I'll invite her...)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What's wrong？
Actually, I won again! The Nikko-Kinugawa Onsen 'Grown-Up School Trip'!
Eh！？
What are the odds, right？
Yeah. Though, hmm... Is it really okay？
Scared of what？
I mean, if we keep winning, hardly anyone else must be entering, right？
Ah, good point...
Are they okay？ That company isn't going under, are they？
Hard to say... Should we pass on it, then？
Hmm...
............Yeah. I still want to go. I really want to do our school trip again.
Alright! Then the question is, when should we go...？
(We can always do our date some other day...)
An overnight school trip, starting ▲月▲▲日▲!
A school trip! Let's take full advantage and have fun! Oh, that reminds me.
Hm？ Never mind me▼ Hehe!
(Alright!! A school trip for just the two of us, ● and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!)
(Phone's ringing... Oh, it's ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.)
Yes. Hello？
Anegasaki
Hello？ It's me.
Hey, what's up？
Hey, hey, we're going on that school trip, right？
Yeah, we are.
Then want to go shopping？ Right now. For stuff for the trip.
Stuff for the trip？
When you put it like that, nothing comes to mind, but anyway! Let's go？
(Alright, time to head out.)
All right then... What should we get？
Anegasaki
First off, a travel guide.
Ah, good idea. What else？
Hmm... Oh! Playing cards! We might feel like playing, you know？
Playing cards, huh. I might have a deck at home...
I have one at home. Hmm...
(Wait a sec... Since it's Kinugawa Onsen, they might have a private bath again...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, don't you need to get a swimsuit？
A swimsuit？ Why？
Well, like back in Atami, there might be a private bath again, you know？
Ah, true. ...Hm？ But that doesn't really fit our setting...？
What setting？
Ah, never mind! Then... maybe I'll buy one just in case？
Alright! I guess that's about it for our shopping.
Anegasaki
Yeah. No need to force it. That'd just be wasteful.
Should we head back, then？
I still have a few things to buy, so why don't you head home without me？
Then ●'ll come along—
No, it's okay. Honestly... You're such a kid.
...Sheesh. See you later, okay？ Don't you dare oversleep the morning of the trip！
Okay, see you.
(Girls must have all kinds of things to take care of...)
(So sleepy... We're leaving pretty early, after all...)
(I wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is here already？)
Anegasaki
Good morning.
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Anegasaki
Morning！ What great weather！
Yeah. Hope it's clear over there, too.
True. Though early summer rain on a school trip could be lovely too, don't you think？
Anegasaki
Morning. Whew, it's hot already, isn't it？ Though maybe it's cooled off a little.
Yeah, I wonder how it is over there？
Hope it's cool. Wouldn't it be nice to get an early taste of autumn？ For that school trip feel.
A school trip, huh...？
Anegasaki
Yep, a school trip...
Hehe！ Alright, and we're off！
Anegasaki
Hmm...
What's wrong？
It doesn't really feel like a school trip yet, does it？
Well, it's our usual train. Once we change trains at Asakusa, that might get us in the mood.
Right, right. Once we're on the express, huh... Makes sense！
Whoa... The Spacia express！ Now it really feels like we're traveling！
Yeah, totally. It's starting to feel like a school trip... Alright！
Come on, boys！ Hurry up and get on board！ Hehe▼
("Boys"？)
Come to think of it, are we doing that again？ Playing classmates？
Anegasaki
Of course. But not until we reach the Spacia.
Do you think so？
Because riding the express really feels like stepping out of the ordinary, doesn't it？
That's true.
So the school trip only starts once we're on the express. Hehe！
The Spacia express... Yeah, definitely out of the ordinary！
Yep. So, starting... now！
Yeah. Shall we get on, then？
Hmm～？ ...Is that how a 'boy' is supposed to talk？
Oh, right. In that case... Come on, Anegasaki, let's go！
Hehe！ That's. It.▼
These seats are huge！ And it's so fast... Wonder how fast we're going？
Anegasaki
Hehe, starting to feel like a school trip now？ Well then, I have a proposal.
A proposal？
Right now, we're on a school trip, right？ So how about we pretend we're the same age？ We're classmates, see.
Classmates？
That's right. And what's more, we aren't dating yet, okay？
Not dating yet!?
Right. But listen？ We're both into each other, and deep down we're hoping this school trip might be our chance to start dating.
Ah, I see... Wait, but why would we―
Come on, haven't you ever dreamed about that sort of thing？ Like in a romance novel. No good？
It's not that it's bad... Just, hmm...
All right, it's decided! Heheh!
(Less of a suggestion, more like she already decided...)
Man, these seats are huge! I thought so on our last school trip too, the Spacia is―
Anegasaki
“Our last school trip”？
Yeah. You know, when we went to Nikko that time.
You don't go on school trips over and over, you know？
Ah... Oh, right.
Oh, look! We're already in Saitama! Woooow, so fast! Heheh!
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s really committing to the bit this time, too...)
Anegasaki
Hey, hey, around here, are we in Tochigi already？
Still a little further, I think？
I see...
Oh, right. There was a buffet counter, wasn't there？ I'm gonna go grab something.
Guess ●'ll go too, then.
Hmm... Would you, though？
That's where you go, “Get mine too!” You know, act all bossy.
Right. Then... Grab me a coffee while you're at it!
Ooh, not bad▼
Jeez! You could just go yourself. Honestly, boys!
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're making this complicated...)
Train Announcement
We will soon be arriving at Kinugawa-Onsen. Please ensure you take all belongings with you...
Anegasaki
Oh, look! They said Kinugawa-Onsen!
Better get ready to get off!
So this is Kinugawa-Onsen...
Anegasaki
Huh, what a pretty station？ I thought it'd feel a lot more rustic.
Totally. Um, the itinerary says the river cruise is first, right？ Shall we go, then？
Hmm... Would you, though？
Huh... Did I say something weird？
A guy in the same class would sound rougher, right？ Like, “Hey, Anegasaki.”
You really want ● to say that？
Of course! Come on, try it？
All right then... Come on, let's go, Anegasaki.
Ah, wait... I mean, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was the one who told me to say it―
I kind of like that...
(Wait, she actually likes this...)
Anegasaki
So this is what Kinugawa Onsen is like... I see, I see~...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, that felt a little too forced...
You think so？ Guess that's enough of that. Remember though, we're not dating yet, okay？
Yes, yes.
Hey, the river cruise is next, right？
Yeah, that's right.
I can't wait!
Alright, shall we go？
Uh... Come on, let's go, Anegasaki!
Yeah, let's go!
(Gotta keep this up...)
Got the tickets.
Anegasaki
Thanks. Is the dock down below？
Looks like it. Uh... Come on, let's go, Anegasaki？
Ah, you're getting the hang of it. Hehe.
Whoa... The current's pretty fast further downstream.
Yeah. The water is so clear... And the mist in the air feels so nice!
Oh, look! Looks like boarding started. Let's go.
...Ah, whoa!
Here, take my hand. It's hard to walk on these rocks.
But... People might start gossiping, you know？ Just kidding, hehe!
Oh, right, before we started dating... Come on, just give me your hand.
Thank you... You're pretty sweet, you know？
(Man, this is starting to feel kind of weird...)
Got the tickets.
Anegasaki
Thanks. We still have a little time. Want to take a walk by the river？
Oops, careful...
You okay？ The footing's bad, want me to hold your hand？
I'm fine! I don't hold hands that easily, mister~!
Boatman
Thanks for waiting, folks! We're ready for boarding!
Coming~!
Ah, whoa!
Come on, quit being stubborn and take my hand.
Full marks for that one...
(Alright, I'm getting the hang of this!)
Whoa... There are some pretty rough rapids further down...
Anegasaki
Yeah... I'm getting a little nervous.
Are you okay？
Boatman
Alright, raise your splash sheets!
Wah, whoa, um...
Watch out, you'll get soaked! Get over here!
Eek!!
Water really splashes... Did you get wet？
I'm fine. Because you pulled me close.
I see. That's good.
You startled me, though. Being so forceful and all... Just kidding, hehe!
(This is starting to get kinda fun...)
Boatman
Alright, please pull up your splash sheets!
Anegasaki
All right!
Whoa!! That was intense... Did you get wet？
Geez, I'm totally fine! Pervert!
Wait, I didn't mean anything funny by it...
Hehe!
Now, look over that way. Doesn't it look like a face？
Oh, is that Gorilla Rock？ Hmm...
Yay, I can see it! Woohoo!
(Doing this, it really feels like we're classmates...)
Anegasaki
Phew, that was fun! You're surprisingly manly, aren't you？
Well, you're surprisingly a scaredy-cat, Anegasaki!
Hehe, not bad! Oh, look, they're selling soft-serve ice cream!
Then let's each get a different flavor and swap!
Huh？ Umm, but...
Oh, right... People don't do that kind of thing before they date？
Yeah... That's true, but... Still, what's gotten into me...？
Oh, the bus is here？
Alright, next we transfer buses to Tobu World Square!
Anegasaki
I'm glad I could spot Gorilla Rock today♪
Still couldn't figure out the other ones？
Yeah, honestly. Guess I've got no knack for it？
It doesn't take real talent, does it？ Wanna grab ice cream again？
Yeah. I wonder if my heart'll flutter again... Hehe!
Look, the bus is here？
Alright, Tobu World Square it is!
Tobu World Square, huh... Hope it's a fun place, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Oh, right. Umm... Hey, Anegasaki!
Yes!? Huh？ What is it？
Lost in thought？
Yeah, a little... You know how we had ice cream earlier？
Yeah.
When you told me to swap, my heart... started racing so fast.
It's silly, right？ I mean, usually we do so much more... right？
Y-Yeah, totally, right？
I wonder why？ Is it because we're playing classmates？
Announcement
Next stop, Tobu World Square. Please make sure not to leave anything behind as you exit...
We're here. 'Where dreams and wonder meet.' Tobu World Square, huh...
Yeah. Hey, say that thing again？ 'Let's go!'
Let's go, Anegasaki!
Hehe, yeah!
Announcement
Next stop, Tobu World Square. Please make sure not to leave anything behind as you exit...
'Where dreams and wonder meet.' Tobu World Square, huh...
Anegasaki
Hey, let's take lots of pictures again, okay？
Yeah.
Hey, do that thing again.
Let's go, Anegasaki!
Ah... See？ It gave me butterflies.
Whoa!? Incredible... A 1/25th scale world, huh.
Anegasaki
Amazing! Look, the National Diet Building! And Tokyo Station, too!
Everything's 1/25th scale, right？ Even the planes at the airport？
Must be.
It feels like it could almost fly with one person, hehe! Come on, let's see the world zone!
It's huge... The real one is 25 times this, right？ Let's see... One, two, three, four...
No way! I can't picture it! Hehe! I'd love to see the real thing...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you really like pyramids, huh？
Love them. Not just pyramids, the Seven Wonders and ancient ruins too. Just imagining standing there...
See, don't you get chills？ Like a thrill running through you.
I think I get what you mean.
Alright, let's take a picture!
Yeah, do it, do it! Make it look like I'm really standing in front of the pyramid, okay？
Anegasaki
Look, look, the Parthenon! You can see the tip of the pyramid behind it! What a bonus!
Definitely a view you can only get here, huh？
Totally. Oh, over there! The Colosseum!
Amazing, it looks like an anthill! I wonder if they kept slaves and lions in those little rooms？
Yeah, it has to be.
And they made them fight for a spectacle, right... Oh! You know, when I was little...
I came up with a strategy in case I was ever forced to fight a lion.
Oh yeah？ What kind？
First, I'd go 'Hyaa!' and jab its eyes, then kick it in the stomach with all my might.
See？ Doesn't it kinda feel like I could win？
Well... No, not really.
You think so？ First, you go 'Hyaa!', right？ Then quickly... Hmm...
（▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s kinda adorable... Alright, gotta get a picture.）
Anegasaki
Look, the Eiffel Tower!
This area's European buildings! The detail on these is amazing...
Look! Sagrada Família, right？ The Arc de Triomphe, Notre-Dame... Ah, over there!
Ah, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Yeah, the Taj Mahal! The carvings are so intricate! It's gorgeous... How lovely...
If it's this big at 1/25th scale... The real thing must be huge.
And you know what？ The real one is made entirely out of marble!
Whoa, really？
Taking a walk there on a moonlit night wearing a sari... It'd be so wonderful. I'd love to go...
(Yeah, better get a photo here too...)
Anegasaki
Haaah... That was so much fun...
You were having a blast, weren't you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hey, you were too! Though... yeah.
I got a little carried away. Even I could tell. Like I was acting like a total kid.
Well, it's a 1/25th scale world tour, after all, right？
Yeah, and... why don't we take a quick break from playing classmates？
A break？
Because you're acting way more boyish than usual.
...You think so？
Yeah... Hehe. Alright, break time's over! Our bus is almost here, right？
That's right! Next up is EDO WONDERLAND Nikko Edomura!
Come on, do the thing! Do it!
Well then... Come on, let's go, Anegasaki!
Yay, so cool!
Man... That was so fun! I feel like I really discovered dreams and wonder!
Anegasaki
We went around the world again, didn't we？ Haaah... I really want to go for real someday...
Yeah, the two of us... Oh, right. We aren't supposed to be dating yet—
Hey, hey. Can we take a little break from playing classmates？
It doesn't have to be a fancy trip. Just one place would be fine, but... a tour of world landmarks—
Let's do that together someday, okay？
Yes...
Fufu, the bus will be here soon, right？ Alright, break time's over. Do that thing for me, okay？
Next up is EDO WONDERLAND Nikko Edomura! Let's go, Anegasaki!
Okay▼
Announcement
Now arriving at the entrance to EDO WONDERLAND Nikko Edomura. Please make sure not to leave any belongings behind...
Ooh... Here we are: EDO WONDERLAND Nikko Edomura.
Anegasaki
EDO WONDERLAND... So does that mean they'll show up？ Ninjas？
Yeah, I bet they will.
Mmm! This might be great—huh？ Hey, that guard-looking guy...
Yeah, he's coming this way...
Gatekeeper
Honored guests, dost thou possess a travel pass？
A travel pass？ Uh...
Oh, I get it! He means tickets!
Right. Here, two adults, please.
You're supposed to say 'de gozaru' there! Right？ Isn't that right？
That it is, de gozaru! Well then, safe travels on your way, de gozaru!
Hehe, this is so fun! Come on, do that thing! The Edo version, okay？
The Edo version!? Uh, well then... Lady Anegasaki, let us depart, de gozaru!
Aha, that's so weird! You're hilarious~!
(Well, you're the one who told me to...)
Announcement
This is the entrance to EDO WONDERLAND Nikko Edomura. Passengers alighting, please make sure not to leave anything behind...
Whoa... We're back at EDO WONDERLAND Nikko Edomura.
Anegasaki
Here we are... The blood-pumping, thrilling EDO WONDERLAND▼
Uh, where's the gatekeeper... Oh, there he is. ...Shall we go？
Huh？ Aren't you gonna do it？ The Edo version.
Come on, you'll just laugh at me...
I won't laugh this time! Come on, please？
Then...
Lady Anegasaki, let us depart, de gozaru!
Hehe! Nin-nin!
Mm, they really went all out with this...
Anegasaki
Yeah. Even the shops and townsfolk look so real. Which means...
There might be ninjas blending in, disguised as townspeople. Look, that person over there looks suspicious.
The backstory goes that deep!?
The 'Temple of Hell', huh... Naturally, we're going in？
Naturally!
I see... They've recreated 'Hell' just as people back then believed it to be...
Look, even the smallest details are crafted so carefully...
(Man, that was kind of a clinical take...)
Eek, what's that!? No, no, nooo!!
(Whoa▼ I feel something soft against my arm...)
*Sigh*...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Were you actually pretty scared？
I told you, being startled is totally different from being scared! Jeez!
Even though you clung to my arm the whole time？
Well, that's just... that's part of the role! For classmate Nene-chan!
(Now she's pouting...)
Anegasaki
Ah, something smells amazing~!
Come to think of it, it's already past noon... Time for some lunch？
Sure! Let's go there, look— 'Kamameshi Matsumaeya'.
Clerk
Welcome~!
Hmm, what should I get？ The 'Shogun Kamameshi' looks good, but so does the 'Kenchin-jiru Set'...
Hey, hey, wanna split them？
I don't mind, ●... but taking another break from playing classmates？
No, it's not that... It's when two people who are starting to realize their feelings for each other—
—naturally share their food for the first time right here... See？ Decided: Kenchin-jiru Set!
(Hearing her say that makes me way too self-conscious...)
Thanks for the meal.
Thank you very much~!
That line is for... the 'Ninja Crow Mansion', huh？
Anegasaki
Ah! That's it! Come on, let's line up!
The stunts were incredible... Just like real ninjas...
Yeah. The stage tricks were wild...
Right, right?! He was so cool~!
Wait, what is it!?
*Sigh*... That ninja was so cool... I can't help admiring that.
W-Well, he was pretty handsome...
Mm... wait, what's this? Could it be that you're getting jealous... maybe？
No, nothing...
Hehe, it's not that！ When I was little, I wanted to be a ninja！
I loved all the tricks and ninjutsu, and used to copy them. That's all I meant, okay？
Oh, is that it! Haha!
...Geez... Hey, can I hold your hand？
Sure... Wait, but as classmates—
This is where Nene-chan, touched that you got jealous, holds your hand. See？
This area feels even more authentic...
Anegasaki
I heard they even use it as a set for period dramas.
Ah, that makes sense!
Fufu. I'm glad you cheered up.
Come on, you were jealous just now, right？
No, that was, well—
No, I was happy. I just thought, 'He still doesn't get it.' Listen, okay？
You see, when a girl is with the person she loves, she doesn't even notice other guys, okay？
I see... Haha...
...Or so she says! Fufu.
Huh？ Wait, so was that the classmate ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Mm？ Oh, I guess so. Which was it？ Hmm...
Now I can't even tell. How silly...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s blushing...)
Head Clerk
The Oiran Procession is starting! Ladies and gentlemen, please enjoy the courtesan's elegant parade!
Anegasaki
Wow, so pretty...
Yeah, she really is...
Her kimono is gorgeous, and the oiran herself is lovely... Must be nice...
Do you want to try it too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yeah, I'd love to. Though... I don't think I could look that beautiful...
I'm sure that's not true.
Hmm... Still, she's just so beautiful, you know？
Yeah, that's true...
See？ I knew it.
Eh？
She really is gorgeous, huh？ That oiran lady.
No, that's not it... Wait, are you jealous？
It's just like with ninjas! You know, admiring the way they look.
So, did you want to be an oiran when you were little？
Huh？ Uh... wait, no...
Hehe! Just kidding♪
(She got me...)
(Alright, checked out all the souvenir shops! I wonder if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is done shopping？)
Anegasaki
Sorry to keep you waiting! Look, look, guess what this is？
A strap？ Oh, it has our names on it...
Yep! Here's one for you. The one that says 'Nene' is yours, okay？
And the one with '▲名前▲' is for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Uh-huh. Hey, look closely. They both say '2-B' on them, don't they？
Yeah. ...What does that mean？
It means we're 'classmates.' See？
Oh, I see...
▲主人公＊▲... Will you keep it as a memory of our school trip？
Of course！
And so, the two took another step forward together. Hehe.
Anegasaki
That was so much fun! EDO WONDERLAND really lived up to the hype!
Yeah, let's come back again sometime, okay？
Yeah. Then all that's left today is heading to the inn, right？
Yeah, the bus should be here soon.
Oh, pretty relaxed, are we？
Relaxed？
Well, I mean... I'm bound to be at least a little nervous, aren't I？ As a girl, you know.
I see... But hey, it's a school trip, remember？
Oh, right... Then that's fine. I can just look forward to it normally.
Jeez, no! It's not like that at all!
Ugh, really... That's not fair!
Anegasaki
Hah...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you a little tired？
Hmm？ Well, this is...
Yeah. It must be a sigh of happiness. Hehe.
Do we take a different bus from here？
Yeah. The bus to the hotel is... Oh, that's it!
Driver
Thanks for waiting! Guests staying at the Kinugawa Plaza Hotel, right this way!
We're here! So this is where we're staying, the Kinugawa Plaza Hotel!
Anegasaki
Wow, it's huge... Hmm？ What is that... giant ball？
Sorry to keep you waiting. We're all checked in. Dinner's at 7, apparently.
Yeah... Hey, this is really where we're staying, right？ It's so fancy, though...
Don't worry.
Attendant
Thank you for waiting. Allow me to show you up. Ma'am, may I take your bags？
Me？ Um, er... Ah, thank you.
Certainly. Right this way, please.
That startled me... I was treating this like a regular school trip...
It's a little... embarrassing, isn't it？
Driver
Sorry to keep you waiting! Guests staying at the Kinugawa Plaza Hotel!
We're here! Kinugawa Plaza Hotel!
Anegasaki
Right, the orb! Thanks for having us again♪ Hehe!
Sorry to keep you waiting. All checked in. Dinner is at seven, they said.
Huh？ Oh, right...
Attendant
Thank you for waiting. Allow me to show you up. Ma'am, may I take your bags？
Oh, no, my husband will carry them, so please don't worry.
Understood. Right this way, then...
I actually said it... Sorry, will you carry them？ Hehe.
That's making me blush...
Attendant
Please make yourself at home and have a relaxing stay.
Whoa!
Anegasaki
Wow, amazing! It's huge, and so stylish...
Yeah... This place is seriously fancy.
Japanese-Western blend？ Ah! Look out the window, that's a bath, right？
A private open-air bath!
I see... So couples can go in together, huh...
Then ● could too—
Too bad for you, huh？ Since it's a school trip. Hehe.
Anegasaki
Hey, should I make some tea？
Oh, thanks!
Mm, what an amazing room... Doesn't it kind of feel like we're in a showroom？
The furniture's pretty chic, too.
Right？ It's lovely, but it doesn't feel like a school trip...
Well, that's not bad either, is it？
I've got it. Here's the story, then.
...What story？
Through a bizarre twist of fate, just the two of us ended up in this luxury room. There!
(Must've been quite a 'twist'...)
Oh yeah. Want to check out the big bath before dinner？
Anegasaki
Oh, that sounds nice! I kinda wanted to wash off some sweat anyway？
Well then, let's meet back here, okay？
Okay.
I might take a while, so sorry in advance, okay？
Take your time.
Hehe, see you later then？ Off I go~♪
'Bath of Treasures', huh! Sounds pretty lucky!
Man, it's huge! A full view of Kinugawa! Feels amazing~!
(Phew... It's washing away all the day's fatigue... I'm getting sleepy...)
